summary: VistaOne, L.P., a Delaware investment fund, filed a Form 8-K reporting a routine continuous private offering of limited partnership units. As of September 1, 2026, the Fund sold unregistered units for aggregate consideration of approximately $24.2 million across Class B, I, R, and S. The filing also disclosed Transactional NAV per unit as of August 31, 2026, ranging from $25.71 for Class R to $33.19 for Class E. The sales were exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and Regulation S. This is an ordinary capital-raising update, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation are stated.
